title: Article semantic bundle v1
description: Portable structural subset for one atomic Hermes-authored summary/categories/keywords bundle. Full validation MUST also run climate_monitor.taxonomy.validate_semantic_bundle against monitoring/taxonomies/article_categories_v1.yaml; the Python validator enforces taxonomy membership and identity, NFC and whitespace normalization, case-insensitive uniqueness, and generic-keyword rejection that this schema alone does not express.
$comment: The Python validator is intentionally stricter: it additionally requires strict UTF-8 encodability and rejects every Unicode format character (category Cf), including directional controls and zero-width characters.
